## Maps and Tokens for Chapter 5

Session 5 continues directly down from Chapter 4's Core Room -- no new dungeon, no
teleport to a fort arena. Load all three maps before players join; reposition tokens
scene by scene on the overview/vault maps rather than reloading between scenes.

### NPC Tokens

No allied garrison NPCs travel into the dungeon:
- **Tribune Lucius is deceased** (fell in Session 3); the contubernium carries his locked iron box alone.
- **Centurion Varro is deceased** (killed in Session 3 cold open; memorial stone at Fort Vindolanda's north gate).
- **Legate Corvinus and Augur Cassia** remain at Fort Vindolanda and greet the party in the epilogue.

| Token | File | Scene | Frame Colour |
|---|---|---|---|
| Vercingetorix Bound | `Maptool/tokens/npcs/named/Vercingetorix_Bound.rptok` | Scene 3 only | Deep red (CR 11, AC 18, HP 150 — his true and final form) |
| Mars | `Maptool/tokens/npcs/creatures/Mars.rptok` | Scene 4, round 3+ (or unmaking ritual) | Divine (CR 20, AC 22/16, HP 300 — Diminished Avatar) |

::: {.dm-note}
Do not place **Fausta_Luperci** or any **Thusnelda** token this session. Both belonged
to the retired fort-arena premise and have no role in the current chapter5.qmd. Their
token files remain on disk, unreferenced.
:::

### Map Files Location

All three maps are this project's own custom SVG battle maps, already built and scouted
for this session (Story 9.1):

```
Maptool/maps/s5_mars_vault_overview.html / .jpg
Maptool/maps/s5_mars_vault.html / .jpg
Maptool/maps/s5_mars_confrontation.html / .jpg
```

Run `bash Maptool/maps/build_campaign_maps.sh` to copy them, along with all tokens
above, into `Maptool/maps/campaign/S5_The_Wrath_of_Mars/` (idempotent).
